24	/// Creates a connection pool for the given SQLite database path and
25	/// initializes all required tables.
26	///
27	/// # Arguments
28	///
29	/// * `path` - Filesystem path or `:memory:` URI for the SQLite database.
30	///
31	/// # Errors
32	///
33	/// Returns an error if the pool cannot be built or table creation fails.
34	pub fn new_pool(path: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Pool> {
35	    // Enable foreign-key enforcement on every checked-out connection.
36	    // SQLite does NOT enforce FK constraints unless `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`
37	    // is set per connection — the setting is not persisted at the file level.
38	    let mgr = SqliteConnectionManager::file(path)
39	        .with_init(|conn| conn.execute_batch("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;"));
40	    let pool = R2d2Pool::builder()
41	        .max_size(5)
42	        .build(mgr)
43	        .context("failed to build connection pool")?;
44	
45	    // Initialize tables using the first connection from the pool.
46	    // SQLite sets WAL journal mode at the file level on first open,
47	    // so subsequent connections to the same file inherit that mode.
48	    let conn = pool
49	        .get()
50	        .context("failed to acquire connection for init")?;
51	    conn.execute_batch("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
52	        .context("failed to enable WAL journal mode")?;
53	
54	    init_tables(&conn)?;
55	    run_migrations(&conn)?;
56	    Ok(pool)
57	}
